page: Amazon Web Services p5.4xlarge is an accelerated computing instance built on the AWS Nitro System, architected for workloads requiring dedicated GPU acceleration alongside high-capacity system memory. The compute layer features an AMD x86_64 processor clocked at 3.6 GHz, configured with 16 dedicated vCPUs distributed across 8 physical cores with 2 threads per core. System memory is sized at 256 GB, which equates to a high allocation of 16 GB per physical core, supporting large in-memory data structures prior to accelerator offload.

Acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPU equipped with 80 GB of dedicated VRAM. Storage is provisioned locally through a 3,800 GB NVMe solid-state drive, offering direct, low-latency disk access for data caching, checkpoints, and processing large datasets without depending exclusively on remote block volumes. Baseline network bandwidth is rated at 100 Gbps, enabling rapid data ingest and cluster synchronization. The instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost and architecture perspective, the p5.4xlarge provides access to NVIDIA Hopper hardware in a smaller slice compared to full multi-GPU nodes. This resource balance makes it effective for workloads requiring substantial GPU memory and fast local scratch space without the cost footprint of an eight-GPU host. Primary target workloads include large language model inference, fine-tuning of medium-sized machine learning models, accelerated data analytics, and GPU-reliant scientific computing.
description: Amazon Web Services p5.4xlarge is an accelerated computing instance powered by the AWS Nitro System, designed for machine learning and high-performance computing workloads. The instance features an AMD x86_64 processor operating at 3.6 GHz with 16 dedicated vCPUs across 8 physical cores, paired with 256 GB of system memory. Hardware acceleration is delivered by a dedicated NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPU equipped with 80 GB of VRAM. For high-speed data staging and scratch storage, the instance includes an integrated 3,800 GB local NVMe SSD. Networking capabilities feature a 100 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, facilitating rapid data transfers. With its combination of Hopper tensor processing, dense local NVMe storage, and high memory capacity, the p5.4xlarge is targeted at large language model inference, deep learning model fine-tuning, molecular dynamics simulations, and demanding data analytics pipelines.
